name: omnisense/omnihub
description: Omnihub: a package hub written once - the npm/UPM registry documents Unity's Package Manager reads (package documents, search, listing), the versions, the tarballs and their shasum/integrity, the hub manifest the hub clients read - for a forge with a database and for a static hub on GitHub Pages alike.

suggest.ext-sodium: A hub's licensing key: its rotation checked, and the author's omnihub key / licence commands (PHP bundles it)
suggest.omnihub/github: A static hub's packages read from GitHub: each repository's releases, their .tgz assets and package.json
suggest.omnibridge/static: To export a static hub (Omnihub\Bridge\Static\HubSite) to a folder GitHub Pages serves
suggest.symfony/yaml: To read hub.yaml (bin/omnihub); hub.json needs nothing
